output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: I converted every witness's clock reading to true time. The kitchen clock is 15 minutes fast, so the piano ran from 22:33 to 22:46 true. Odile's salon clock is 5 minutes slow, so the doctor left at 22:28 salon time, which is 22:33 true. That matches the piano start. Girard's watch is 4 minutes slow, so the repeater bells he heard at 22:34 on his watch were at 22:38 true, while the piano was playing. Félix's watch is 20 minutes slow, so the thump he heard at 22:18 on his watch was also 22:38 true. The blow therefore fell at 22:38, during the piano. The doctor was out of the salon from 22:33 to 22:46 true, and Odile was at the piano, so he is the only one without an alibi for 22:38. Lina was in the kitchen, Girard was in the street, and Félix was in the library. The doctor also lied about the time. He said he went out at a quarter to eleven by his watch, which runs 2 minutes ahead, so that would be 22:43 true. In fact he left at 22:33 true. The stopped regulator at 10:05 was faked.
